# Lab 4.1: SELECT Essentials

## What We Are Going to Do
Practise filtering, aggregation, ROLLUP/CUBE/GROUPING SETS, QUALIFY and `SELECT * EXCEPT/REPLACE` on the thelook e-commerce dataset.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the module dataset.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

</code></pre>

2. **[SQL] Use `EXCEPT` and `REPLACE`.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT * EXCEPT (email, street_address)
       REPLACE (UPPER(country) AS country)
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users`
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Subtotals with ROLLUP and CUBE.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT country, gender, COUNT(*) AS users, GROUPING(country) AS is_total_row
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users`
WHERE country IN ('India', 'Brasil', 'Japan')
GROUP BY ROLLUP (country, gender)
ORDER BY country, gender;

SELECT country, traffic_source, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users`
WHERE country IN ('India', 'Japan')
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((country), (traffic_source), ());</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Keep only the latest order per user with QUALIFY.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT user_id, order_id, created_at
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders`
WHERE TRUE
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) = 1
LIMIT 20;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] Run a HAVING query from bq.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(retail_price),2) AS avg_price
 FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
 GROUP BY category HAVING avg_price &gt; 60 ORDER BY avg_price DESC'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `EXCEPT` / `REPLACE` | Drop or transform columns without listing all of them |
| `ROLLUP` | Subtotal and grand-total rows (NULL in grouped columns) |
| `QUALIFY` | Filters on window results, one row per user |
| `HAVING` | Filters after aggregation |
